Scenes 39-49 as quick shots with a caption each, every recorded line and sound kept; scene 50 follows as usual. Plays to the director's song "Hounds" (public/film/audio/Hounds (3) (1).mp3, copied as hounds.mp3), 11 October 2026: the caption shots are fitted to the song. 16 October 2026, the director: Hounds plays once, no loop, and runs on under scenes 50 and 51 until it finishes (before Vera's apartment, 52, where Dark Hills Blues takes over); the shots are no longer fitted to the song (songRunsOn).

shots.text: Jack's eyes open. Tyres on gravel.
Four black cars. Five masked men.
They split up without a word.
He takes the receipts. Nothing else.
Two masked men walk in. The first is the man from the Kanda rain.
A burst into the ceiling. Plaster rains down.
The souvenir case shatters.
Boots on the stairs.
Jack goes the other way, toward the bath.
Gunfire down the corridor. The screens burst apart.
Through the bathroom door.
Once. Twice. It won't move.
The third time, the window gives.
Down the wet tin. He catches the gutter.
Mrs. Noda, crouched in the kitchen. Into the pantry.
One gunman in the lobby. Mr. Noda behind the counter.
Jack kills the lights.
The gunman fires blind into the dark.
In that half-second, Jack has him.
The pink payphone starts to ring.
The old couple, together in the dark.
Gunfire chases him through the mud.
He dives behind the truck. Rounds punch through it.
The keys are in it. The engine coughs. Dies.
A round through the windscreen.
It catches. Roars.
Through the farm gate.
They don't chase him. They don't need to.
Inside, the payphone is still ringing.
